content: {"paper_id":"W2468752595","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"subspace-clustering","exact_quote":"Subspace Clustering","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确以子空间聚类为研究任务；摘要进一步围绕LRR探索子空间结构并提出半监督聚类方法。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Semi-Supervised","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题与摘要明确为半监督设定，利用标签/监督信息指导聚类与亲和矩阵学习。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"The affinity matrix is obtained by seeking a non-negative low-rank matrix that represents each sample as a linear combination of others.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确采用非负低秩矩阵表示样本间亲和关系，属显式低秩建模。"},{"keyword_id":"sparse-representation","exact_quote":"We also explicitly impose the sparse constraint on the affinity matrix such that the affinity matrix obtained by NNLRR is non-negative low-rank and sparse.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"对亲和矩阵施加稀疏约束，使样本以少量其他样本的线性组合表示，满足稀疏表示机制。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"the supervision information is explicitly incorporated to guide the affinity matrix construction","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确在优化中学习/构建样本间亲和矩阵，监督信息参与指导该结构，符合图结构学习定义。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","reason_zh":"摘要提到Gaussian fields and harmonic functions方法，但未说明其是否以图拉普拉斯/流形一致性约束形式加入优化，机制证据不足。"}],"input_issues":[]}
